head_commit.message:
fix: improve CIAM OIDC failure diagnostics (#166) (#208)

* fix: Update WawkR brand references to Pawzum in agents/skills (#140)

Updated brand name from WawkR to Pawzum in:
- .github/agents/design-auditor.agent.md (4 replacements)
- .github/agents/sre-agent.agent.md (2 replacements)
- .github/agents/ui-designer.agent.md (3 replacements)
- .github/skills/audit-consistency/SKILL.md (3 replacements)
- .github/skills/create-screen/SKILL.md (2 replacements)
- .github/skills/iconography/SKILL.md (2 replacements)

Total: 16 replacements in display names, descriptions, and titles.

Closes #140

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(web): replace remaining wawkr brand strings with pawzum (#204)

- telemetry.ts: cloud role wawkr-web -> pawzum-web (App Insights + server console)
- auth-identity.ts: alias domain users.noreply.wawkr.local -> users.noreply.pawzum.local
- test fixtures: app.wawkr.com -> app.pawzum.com, wawkr.local -> pawzum.local
- e2e/fixtures.ts: update comment
All 184 tests passing.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* docs(ops): document Azure Front Door custom domain TLS propagation window (#191)

- Add operations runbook explaining 1-4 hour cert propagation timeline
- Document expected user-facing symptoms: ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID
- Provide monitoring commands and troubleshooting steps
- Include DNS apex domain alias record requirements
- Add workflow comment referencing TLS propagation behavior

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(auth): update all OAuth callback URLs to pawzum.com (#154)

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* docs: document Entra External ID social provider coverage (#202)

- Document native CIAM support for Google, Facebook, Apple, GitHub, MSA
- Note custom OIDC federation required for X/Twitter and Instagram
- Add account linking recommendations for profile merging
- Include Pawzum-specific recommendations for provider configuration

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* docs: add GitHub Actions runner routing guide (#193)

Create comprehensive documentation for runner routing strategy across all WawkR workflows. Includes:
- Complete inventory of all 17 workflows and their runner configurations
- Decision guide for GitHub-hosted vs self-hosted runner selection
- Identification of 8 workflows accessing private Azure resources
- Recommendations for shared-build-agents runner migration

Added TODO comments to workflows with private resource access:
- deploy-api.yml (ACR, Container Apps, App Configuration)
- deploy-database.yml (private database, Key Vault)
- deploy-iac.yml (resource group deployment)
- deploy-sre.yml (SRE stack deployment)
- deploy-web.yml (ACR, Container Apps, Front Door)
- destroy-iac.yml (Key Vault, resource deletion)
- release-preflight.yml (Container App validation)
- release-postcheck.yml (Container App probing)

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* chore(iac): deprecate B2C config after CIAM cutover (#167)

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(ux): update sign-in page and manifest to Pawzum branding (#158)

head_commit.message:
feat(ciam): wire CIAM secrets to Container App via Key Vault and fix bootstrap cross-tenant app registration

- bootstrap.ps1/sh: replace az ad --tenant (unsupported) with MS Graph REST API
  using az account get-access-token for cross-tenant CIAM app registration
- bootstrap now sets ENTRA_EXTERNAL_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/TENANT_ID GitHub secrets
- iac/backend/container-app.bicep: add entraExternalEnabled param + KV secret
  refs (entra-external-client-id/secret/tenant-id) + env vars for Container App
- iac/main.bicep: pass entraExternalEnabled=!empty(entraExternalClientId)
- deploy-iac.yml: pass entraExternalClientId/Secret/TenantId as Bicep params

GitHub secrets ENTRA_EXTERNAL_CLIENT_ID, ENTRA_EXTERNAL_CLIENT_SECRET,
ENTRA_EXTERNAL_TENANT_ID are now set. Next deploy will write them to Key Vault
and expose them to the Container App as env vars so entra-external OIDC
provider registers and login works at app.pawzum.com.

Closes #215 (bootstrap auto-detection)

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

head_commit.message:
fix(auth): auto-detect enterprise OIDC issuer in bootstrap scripts (#215)

- Replace hardcoded 'ibuyspy' enterprise OIDC issuer fallback with dynamic
  auto-detection via GitHub GraphQL API (requires 'read:enterprise' scope)
- Fall back gracefully to the public issuer with a clear warning when detection
  fails (token lacks scope or no enterprise found)
- Env var overrides GITHUB_OIDC_ISSUER / AZURE_OIDC_ISSUER remain supported
- Add resolveEntraExternalIssuer() helper to construct CIAM issuer URLs from
  tenant name or explicit ENTRA_EXTERNAL_ISSUER env var
- Add resolveFirstNonEmptyEnv() utility to simplify env var coalescing
- Wire resolveEntraExternalIssuer into auth.ts for the entra-external provider
- Wrap social provider registrations in try/catch for graceful degradation

Closes #215

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* feat(admin): scaffold apps/admin Next.js app for service admin interface (#183, #179)

- package.json with Next.js 16.2.6, React 19, Tailwind v4, @wawkr/types, @wawkr/tokens
- next.config.ts (standalone output, minimal config)
- tsconfig.json mirroring web app settings
- src/app/layout.tsx with Pawzum Admin metadata
- src/app/page.tsx dashboard with nav to all sections
- src/app/users/page.tsx user management stub
- src/app/content/page.tsx content moderation stub
- src/app/settings/page.tsx feature flags + instance config stub
- src/app/instances/page.tsx white-label instance management stub (#179)
- src/app/api/health/route.ts health check endpoint

- Dev server on port 3001

* feat(backoffice): scaffold apps/backoffice Next.js app for internal ops (#183)

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(tests): coerce sql count to number; skip avatar fetch in CI seed (#174)

- stats/route.ts: wrap all sql<number> aggregates with Number() to handle
  PostgreSQL returning count(*) as a string via the pg driver
- seed.ts: skip external avatar HTTP fetches when CI=true or
  SEED_ON_STARTUP=true; guards in the blob-insert block already handle
  null, so reseed completes in <1s and no longer races the afterAll timeout

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

  eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals + typescript config as apps/web

feat(sre): Azure SRE agent with availability tests and alerting (#182)

* chore(basecoat): fix version.json drift to 3.28.0, resolve CHANGELOG

- version.json: correct to 3.28.0 to match pinned ref
- CHANGELOG.md: resolve merge, keep latest upstream entries

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* feat(sre): Azure SRE agent with alerting, diagnostics, workbook (#181)

- iac/sre/sre-main.bicep: orchestrator referencing existing app stack
  by name, wires action group, diagnostic settings, alerts, workbook
- iac/sre/action-group.bicep: email / webhook / PagerDuty routing
- iac/sre/alerts.bicep: 13 tiered alert rules (Sev0–Sev3) covering
  Container App (5xx, zero replicas, latency, CPU, memory),
  PostgreSQL (connections, CPU, storage, memory),
  Storage (availability, errors), App Insights exceptions,
  availability tests, Key Vault unauthorized access, container restarts
- iac/sre/workbook.bicep: Azure Monitor workbook with per-layer health
  tabs (Overview, API, Database, Storage, Front Door)
- .github/workflows/deploy-sre.yml: OIDC deploy workflow, unique
  concurrency group, cancel-in-progress: false for safe deployments
- .github/agents/sre-agent.agent.md: Copilot SRE runbook agent with
  resource topology, incident runbooks, KQL query patterns, SLO queries

Closes #181

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* feat(sre): add URL availability tests for app.pawzum.com (#181)

Add availability-tests.bicep with classic ping (HTTP GET) tests for:
- https://app.pawzum.com (homepage)
- https://app.pawzum.com/api/health (app API health)
- https://api.pawzum.com/health (direct API health)

Each test runs from 5 global locations (East US, West US, North Europe,
UK South, Southeast Asia) every 5 minutes with a 30s timeout.
Sev1 metric alerts fire when 2+ locations fail simultaneously.

Wire availabilityTests module into sre-main.bicep; bicep build passes.

head_commit.message:
fix(tests): coerce sql count to number; skip avatar fetch in CI seed (#174)

- stats/route.ts: wrap all sql<number> aggregates with Number() to handle
  PostgreSQL returning count(*) as a string via the pg driver
- seed.ts: skip external avatar HTTP fetches when CI=true or
  SEED_ON_STARTUP=true; guards in the blob-insert block already handle
  null, so reseed completes in <1s and no longer races the afterAll timeout

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* feat(sre): Azure SRE agent with alerting, diagnostics, workbook (#181)

  by name, wires action group, diagnostic settings, alerts, workbook
- iac/sre/action-group.bicep: email / webhook / PagerDuty routing
- iac/sre/alerts.bicep: 13 tiered alert rules (Sev0–Sev3) covering
  Container App (5xx, zero replicas, latency, CPU, memory),
  PostgreSQL (connections, CPU, storage, memory),
  Storage (availability, errors), App Insights exceptions,
  availability tests, Key Vault unauthorized access, container restarts
- iac/sre/workbook.bicep: Azure Monitor workbook with per-layer health
  tabs (Overview, API, Database, Storage, Front Door)
- .github/workflows/deploy-sre.yml: OIDC deploy workflow, unique
  concurrency group, cancel-in-progress: false for safe deployments
- .github/agents/sre-agent.agent.md: Copilot SRE runbook agent with
  resource topology, incident runbooks, KQL query patterns, SLO queries

Closes #181

workflow_runs.display_title: fix(iac): remove unsupported postgres service linker; gate DNS RBAC b…

head_commit.message:
fix(iac): remove unsupported postgres service linker; gate DNS RBAC behind flag

Two IaC deploy failures fixed:

1. PostgreSQL Flexible Server is not a supported target for
   Microsoft.ServiceLinker/linkers (TargetTypeNotSupported).
   Removed postgresConnector resource and postgresServerId param.
   DB connectivity is already handled via the 'database-url' KV secret
   injected as a container app secret reference.

2. DNS RBAC cross-RG module requires Owner/UAA on rg-core-services.
   The GH Actions SP only has Contributor on wawkr-rg-dev.
   Added deployDnsRbac bool param (default false) to gate the module.
   The RBAC assignment was already applied manually on 2026-05-22.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

workflow_runs.display_title: fix: degrade gracefully when DB unavailable in getRuntimeAuthProvider…

head_commit.message:
fix: degrade gracefully when DB unavailable in getRuntimeAuthProviderConfig (#163)

Wrap the app_config DB query in try/catch so that when DATABASE_URL is
missing or the connection fails, auth provider availability falls back to
env-var-only mode. The DB row is an optional admin override layer — env
vars (AUTH_PROVIDER_LOCAL_ENABLED, AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ID, etc.) are
the source of truth for provider availability.

This unblocks /api/public/auth-providers and the signIn callback so login
works even when the DB connection is broken.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

head_commit.message:
fix: container .next/cache perms, auth bypass flag, Pawzum brand logo

- Dockerfile: pre-create /app/apps/web/.next/cache and chown to nextjs user
  Fixes EACCES errors that broke ISR, auth callbacks, and all runtime cache writes

- AUTH_BYPASS_USER=1: new server env var to skip auth entirely
  - middleware.ts: redirects /login → / when bypass is active
  - lib/auth.ts: getCurrentUser/getCurrentUserId return synthetic BYPASS_USER without any DB call
  - BypassBanner: amber fixed banner shown in root layout when bypass is on

- BrandLogo component: replaces /logo.png Image with inline SVG paw + wordmark
  Used in landing page nav and login page; consistent Pawzum brand identity

head_commit.message:
fix(web): resolve 4 ESLint errors blocking CI on main

- (dashboard)/page.tsx: move Date.now() to useState lazy init before
  early returns (fixes impure-function-in-render + hooks-after-return)
- offline/page.tsx: replace <a href='/'> with <Link> from next/link
  (fixes @next/next/no-html-link-for-pages)
- ThemeProvider.tsx: use lazy useState init for useMediaQuery so no
  synchronous setState in effect (fixes cascading-renders lint error)
- ThemeProvider.tsx: derive theme from userTheme ?? getDefaultSkinId()
  instead of useEffect setState (eliminates set-state-in-effect)

Closes #147

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

head_commit.message:
refactor(bootstrap): strip RG/RBAC/deploy from cloud setup

Bootstrap --cloud now only wires OIDC: app reg, service principal,
federated credentials, GitHub secrets/vars, and production environment.

RG creation, RBAC, ACR, and Bicep deploy belong to the IaC workflow
to avoid chicken-egg ordering issues. Two new thin scripts trigger
the workflow instead:
  - scripts/deploy-iac-workflow.ps1
  - scripts/deploy-iac-workflow.sh

Closes #143 (billing blocker moot — bootstrap no longer runs deploy-database)
